lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five discernible horizontal rows. The centroids of these clusters form a staggered grid pattern extending from the posterior margin of the fifth gill slit towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of intermediate luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming a matrix of anchor nodes particularly prominent in the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Non-uniform distribution of high-luminance blobs on the dorsal fin surface, with higher concentration observed along the anterior margin and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct elongated secondary silhouette with high-contrast banding positioned ventrally to the main flank body.
